Accomplishment
1. As Chief, Division of Fluid Mineral Lease Operations and Reservoir Management at the HQ directs two Branches to oversee the entire Fluid Mineral development operations on Federal Lands. BLM 1988-1992

2. As Chief, Division of Mineral Policy and Economic Analysis manages staff to provide/update economic guidance to field offices for evaluation of lease value, royalty matter and any major economic issue related to mineral leasing and operations. BLM 1992-1995

3. Serves as senior Mineral Management Advisor to Assistant Director for Land and Minerals. BLM 1996-2003

Notable Accomplishments

As Chief, Division of Fluid Mineral Lease Operations and Reservoir Management at the HQ directs two Branches to oversee the entire Fluid Mineral development operations on Federal Lands. BLM 1988-1992

As Chief, Division of Mineral Policy and Economic Analysis manages staff to provide/update economic guidance to field offices for evaluation of lease value, royalty matter and any major economic issue related to mineral leasing and operations. BLM 1992-1995

Serves as senior Mineral Management Advisor to Assistant Director for Land and Minerals. BLM 1996-2003

Published 知命開運手邊冊:新科學的命運觀 (2007); English version: Genetic Fate, Environmental Chances and Your Destiny: Science-based Theory of Destiny (2016)
